consensus: Prune the two-sided polynomial moving-prefix family before candidate estimation; under the R5 negligible-tail premise it is the same growth obligation as the full remainder. Open a child requiring a proper source statistic with a positive DifferenceWitness.
disagreements: Whether the next proper statistic should be one-sided, localized in prime scale, or cancellation-functional is intentionally unresolved.
